privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey must have the title 'Smart Home Hub Feature Prioritization Study'. Format code 'G' corresponds to 'Group by group'. Question types are: X (Text Display), R (Ranking), and N (Numerical Input). The ranking question must have exactly 8 items: Voice control, Energy monitoring, Security integration, Lighting control, Climate scheduling, Remote access, Ecosystem compatibility, and Privacy controls. The survey must be activated at the end.
